approval_basis: User selected these four families as the strongest archetype-faithful results produced so far.
purpose: Calibration set for compiler changes and representatives for the first catalogue production clusters.

shared_success_contract.repeatable_capacity: Only ordinary middle bays or floors may repeat.
shared_success_contract.release_gate: A structural pass remains review-only until an explicit multiscale visual_approval.json exists.

why_it_worked: The selected variant, not the Victorian parent, controlled the elevation and materials.
The shallow crown and patterned mansard remained fixed instead of becoming another repeated floor.
Portico, rustication, dormers and roof cresting were semantic assemblies with construction depth.
The façade hierarchy was authored as shopfront base, ordered middle, continuous balcony datums and mansard crown.
Dormers, recessed shopfronts and the softened corner were corrected as geometry rather than repainted pixels.
Only the neutral limestone bay rhythm remained repeatable.
A true Cerdà chamfer replaced the generic rectangular corner.
Diagonal skins, glazing and balconies were oriented onto every chamfer face.
The corner entrance, balcony datums and cornice remained fixed while ordinary residential bays repeated.
The rejected flat rectangular version was replaced by a dedicated chapel-hall massing graph.
The central tower, octagonal lantern, four terminal towers, buttresses and roof were fixed geometry.
All exposed tower planes received registered skins and construction-depth glazing.
